_about: Material cards for pk_materials. Every value is {value, unit, source, honesty}; honesty in {standard_value, datasheet, typical_range, derived}. A typical_range value is the midpoint and carries its range. Densities are what mass_g multiplies by; the rest is what a check reads. A card may be `anisotropic`, in which case it names directions in its property keys (E_0, tensile_90) and lists in `refuses` the isotropic scalars it will not invent, each with the reason and the fix.

abs.notes: Same printing caveat as pla: bulk figures, 100% solid assumed.

aluminium_6061.notes: EN 1999-1-1 3.2.5 prints rho 2700 and E 70000 as design values for all wrought alloys, but that text was not fetched this session, so nothing here is claimed as standard. Yield is temper-dependent; the T6 range is served.

aluminium_6082.notes: Same caveat as aluminium_6061: EN 1999-1-1 design values not fetched, so served as a handbook range. Yield is temper-dependent; the T6 range is served.

brass_cw614n.notes: Lead content makes CW614N RoHS-exempt only under specific annexes; the card carries mechanics, not compliance.

density.source: rule of mixtures at the datasheet's own basis: 0.60 x 1760 (T300 fibre, Toray TORAYCA T300 data sheet, Rev. 04/22/2025 (composite values normalized to 60% fibre volume, cured with #2500 epoxy at 130 C)) + 0.40 x rho_matrix, rho_matrix 1150-1300 kg/m3 for a cured laminating epoxy; the range below is that assumption's whole span

E_0.source: Toray TORAYCA T300 data sheet, Rev. 04/22/2025 (composite values normalized to 60% fibre volume, cured with #2500 epoxy at 130 C), tensile modulus ASTM D3039

tensile_0.source: Toray TORAYCA T300 data sheet, Rev. 04/22/2025 (composite values normalized to 60% fibre volume, cured with #2500 epoxy at 130 C), tensile strength ASTM D3039

tensile_90.source: Toray TORAYCA T300 data sheet, Rev. 04/22/2025 (composite values normalized to 60% fibre volume, cured with #2500 epoxy at 130 C), 90 deg tensile strength ASTM D3039

compressive_0.source: Toray TORAYCA T300 data sheet, Rev. 04/22/2025 (composite values normalized to 60% fibre volume, cured with #2500 epoxy at 130 C), compressive strength SACMA SRM 1R-94

shear_ip.source: Toray TORAYCA T300 data sheet, Rev. 04/22/2025 (composite values normalized to 60% fibre volume, cured with #2500 epoxy at 130 C), in-plane shear strength ASTM D3518

E.reason: a laminate has no single Young's modulus: this card serves E_0 = 140 000 N/mm2 along the fibres, and across them it is roughly a tenth of that
E.fix: read E_0, or give the layup and ask for the laminate's own modulus

yield.reason: CFRP does not yield, it breaks, and the strength depends on the direction: the same datasheet prints 1820 N/mm2 along the fibres and 76 across them, a factor of 24
yield.fix: read tensile_0, tensile_90 or compressive_0 and say which direction the load takes

G.reason: shear is in-plane, interlaminar or transverse and they are different numbers

nu.reason: a UD laminate has two Poisson's ratios (nu_12 and nu_21) and this datasheet prints neither
nu.fix: supply nu_12 from your own laminate data

cfrp_t300_ud.notes: UNIDIRECTIONAL, and that is the least representative layup for a real part: a woven or quasi-isotropic laminate of the same fibre is far stiffer across the part and far less stiff along it. Density is what the kernel uses for mass and is direction-free; every stiffness and strength here is the 0 deg value unless its name says otherwise.

E.source: engineering handbook range, dry as moulded

yield.source: engineering handbook range, dry as moulded

nylon_pa6.notes: PA6 absorbs water; conditioned stiffness can be a third of the dry figure. The card serves dry-as-moulded.

pla.notes: A printed part is not solid: infill and layer adhesion scale mass and strength well below these bulk figures. mass_g assumes 100% solid.

yield.source: engineering handbook range, Rp0.2 annealed (EN 10088-2 sets a 190 minimum)

stainless_1_4301.notes: EN 10088-2 was not fetched this session; only the density is served as a standard value.

steel_100cr6.notes: Strength depends entirely on heat treatment (annealed vs through-hardened 60+ HRC), so no yield is claimed.

yield.source: engineering handbook range for EN 10130 DC01 (the standard sets only an upper ReH of 280)

tensile.source: engineering handbook range for EN 10130 DC01 (Rm 270-410)

steel_dc01.notes: EN 10130 was not fetched this session; strength is served as a range, not a standard number. DC01 is a forming grade - ReH is capped, not guaranteed.

steel_s275.notes: ReH drops with thickness above 16 mm (EN 10025-2 tables it); the card serves the t <= 16 value only.

steel_s355.notes: ReH drops with thickness above 16 mm (EN 10025-2 tables it); the card serves the t <= 16 value only.
